oracle.source: Retained public-API DoWhy 0.14 backdoor.linear_regression run on the exact retained CSV and graph; independent structural coefficient 2 is checked separately.

reference_review.scope: One 200-row fixed noiseless linear design, graph, adjustment set, scalar ATE and preserved DoWhy output.
reference_review.independence_basis: The harness imports only released DoWhy/public graph and tabular APIs and standard-library comparison code. No product or test implementation is imported. Numerical estimation is delegated to the upstream package; the separate structural truth is the recorded coefficient 2, not product agreement. The harness has no transitive repository comparison helper.
reference_review.historical_exposure: Original historical author exposure cannot be established. Current authorship used public API documentation; search results also exposed CausalModel orchestration wrapper signatures, not numeric estimation or test source. No upstream implementation/test code was copied.
reference_review.redistribution: Repository-authored harness remains MIT OR Apache-2.0. Upstream packages are installed from the locked environment and are not vendored or imported by product runtime or ordinary CI. Original numeric values and historical exposure records are preserved.
reference_review.limitations: This treatment is a deterministic step of Z and violates conditional positivity. The comparison establishes a fitted contrast under the specified globally linear noiseless model and its parametric extrapolation; graph identification output alone does not establish nonparametric identification, overlap, observational causal validity or calibrated uncertainty. One fixed design is not broad method-family coverage.
